title: Foreign fund registered on TASE ("קרן חוץ"): exchange rate or CPI as the index

source.title: Tax Authority capital-market taxation department, "ניכוי מס במקור – קרנות חוץ (Foreign Funds)", 4.7.2019, section 4.1.5 (capitax.co.il mirror)

threshold_pct.notes: Minimum share of the foreign fund's investments, in each tax year, in assets whose interest or inflationary amount is computed by the fund's main currency rate, for the exchange rate (not the CPI) to be the index. The source is an administrative letter, not law (update_rule 'fixed in regulation' is the nearest value in the schema list); whether it is still in force was not confirmed (Q10). No gov.il copy was reachable.
